newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U says to float Biacore unit in Sweden.
newsitem.headline: P&U says to float Biacore unit in Sweden.

text.p: Swedish/U.S. drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc on Thursday said it planned to list its Biacore medical instruments unit on the Stockholm bourse via a global share issue.
The company said it set the price range for the issue at between 98-112 crowns per share ($15-17 per American Depository Share, ADS).
P&U said it would make a global offer of five million shares in Stockholm and on the NASDAQ National Market System in the United States.
The spin-off would take the form of a new issue of 1.5 million shares, along with the sale of 3.5 million shares from Pharmacia & Upjohn's own holding.
The offer will reduce Pharmacia & Upjohn's holding in Biacore to around 49 percent of the shares and votes in the company.
In addition, P&U said it had earmarked 750,000 shares for an over allotment option, which would, if utilised, reduce its holding in Biacore to 41 percent.
The offer valued Biacore at 1.02 billion crowns on the basis of the mid-point of the 98 to 112 crown share price range, the company said.
Of the 525 million crowns raised by the offer, 158 million crowns will go to Biacore and the remaining 367 million to P&U.
In addition, P&U said it would inject 82 million crowns into Biacore "via a new issue in connection with the preparations for the offer," the company said.
The offer period will run from November 13 to November 22, Pharmacia & Upjohn said. Goldman Sachs International is the global coordinator and lead manager for the project.

It said Biacore would use the funds received to improve its distribution network and expand into new business areas such as food analysis. It would also consider "selective acquisitions of complementary technologies," P&U said.
Pharmacia & Upjohn said it intended to retain a substantial minority interest in Biacore and its projected growth, while Biacore would obtain greater independence and flexibility.
